values.meaning: Grievous Wounds duration applied by Poison Trail

values.binNote: Wiki description gives no explicit percentage for the Grievous Wounds strength, only naming the effect via tooltip link; the 40% value is taken from InsanityPotion.GrievousAmount in the bin.

values.meaning: Grievous Wounds refresh interval while poison persists
values.quote: refreshes every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while the {{tip|poison}} persists
values.binNote: No bin row carries this refresh-interval value; the sheet's PoisonTrail.TicksPerSecond=4 (0.25s per tick) matches but is not part of the R slot's own data values, so it is not named as a source here.

mechanics.claim: Insanity Potion grants bonus AP, bonus armor, bonus magic resist, bonus movement speed, bonus health regeneration, and bonus mana regeneration for its duration.
mechanics.quote: empowers himself for 25 seconds with {{sti|ap|{{as|ability power}}}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health regeneration}}}}, and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' mana regeneration}}}}

mechanics.claim: While Insanity Potion is active, Poison Trail additionally applies Grievous Wounds to targets standing in it, refreshing periodically while they remain in the poison.
mechanics.quote: During this time, ''{{ai|Poison Trail|Singed}}'' additionally applies {{tip|Grievous Wounds}} for 1 second, which refreshes every {{fd|0.25}} seconds while the {{tip|poison}} persists.
